proposed_widenings.name: grant_mastery_access
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants the character the ability to use the mastery property of N chosen weapon kinds with which they have proficiency. The existing grant_proficiency atom covers weapon category proficiency (attack/damage eligibility), not mastery-property eligibility. Mastery properties are already modeled as separate MasteryRecord units; this atom would link a character to the ability to activate those records for chosen weapon kinds. No existing EffectAtom variant covers 'you may use the mastery property of weapons of kind X'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of two kinds of weapons of your choice with which you have proficiency, such as Daggers and Shortbows.

proposed_widenings.name: rest_reconfigurable_choice on PassiveMechanics or grant_mastery_access
proposed_widenings.justification: The feature allows replacing all chosen weapon kinds after each Long Rest. This is a rest-triggered full rebuild of a build-time choice — not modeled by any existing reset_cadence or activation pattern. The current surface has rest-triggered resource refills but no mechanism for rest-triggered reassignment of a passive grant parameter.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change the kinds of weapons you chose. For example, you could switch to using the mastery properties of Scimitars and Shortswords.

notes: Structurally identical gap to barbarian_weapon_mastery_l1 (also classified atom_widening). The passive family (family='passive') is structurally correct — the feature is always-on while held. The sole blocker is the missing grant_mastery_access effect atom. The Rogue differs from the Barbarian variant only in (a) allowing proficient weapons of any kind rather than Simple/Martial Melee, and (b) replacing ALL choices on long rest rather than one. Neither difference changes the widening classification.
